safeguard: A declined transfer changes no balances
default_label: The credit happens before the balance check

variants.label: The credit runs in a finally block
variants.root_cause: transfer() credits the destination in a finally block, so the credit runs even when the balance check raises InsufficientFundsError.

edits.find:
fee_cents = transfer_fee_cents(amount_cents)
    if source.balance_cents < amount_cents + fee_cents:
        raise InsufficientFundsError("insufficient funds")

    source.balance_cents -= amount_cents + fee_cents
    destination.balance_cents += amount_cents
edits.replace:
fee_cents = transfer_fee_cents(amount_cents)
    try:
        if source.balance_cents < amount_cents + fee_cents:
            raise InsufficientFundsError("insufficient funds")
        source.balance_cents -= amount_cents + fee_cents
    finally:
        destination.balance_cents += amount_cents
